title: CYBRIK Merkle Audit Proof Contract Schema v1
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 defining binary Merkle tree inclusion proofs, epoch roots, leaf digests (sha256), audit path sequences, and Ed25519 signature envelopes (Pillars 5, 9, 10). Governs immutable ledger verification, cryptographic inclusion proofs, cross-epoch consistency, and sovereign non-repudiation.

epoch_id.description: Audit epoch or ledger block identifier to which the proof belongs.

tenant_id.description: Authoritative tenant identifier governing the ledger.

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves committed to this epoch Merkle tree.

leaf_index.description: 0-based index of the target leaf within the Merkle tree.

leaf_digest.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the leaf record.

epoch_root.description: Root hash of the Merkle tree for this epoch.

hash_algorithm.description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used for node computation.

audit_path.description: Ordered sequence of sibling hashes and positions from leaf to epoch root.

signature_envelope.description: Cryptographic Ed25519 signature certifying the epoch root.

ledger_event_ref.description: Optional reference to the underlying ledger transaction or security event.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest over the canonical JSON representation of the inclusion proof manifest.

auditPathNode.description: A single sibling node in the Merkle audit path.

position.description: Relative position of the sibling node ('left' or 'right').

hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the sibling node.

level.description: Tree level of this node (0 = leaf sibling level).

ed25519SignatureEnvelope.description: Ed25519 digital signature envelope binding the epoch root to the sovereign notary authority.

public_key_hex.description: 64-character lowercase hex string representing the 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

signature_hex.description: 128-character lowercase hex string representing the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

signer_identity.description: URI or name identifying the sovereign notary service or signer.

ledgerEventRef.description: Contextual reference to the source ledger event.
